services: Abdion provides a multi-tenant SaaS platform to build AI agents that talk to customers over WhatsApp
and REST API. Agents use knowledge bases
and metered billing. Includes a flow builder
Abdion.value_proposition: Abdion lets any business launch AI agents across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, voice, web, and API in minutes — grounded in their own knowledge, tools, and workflows, with human handoff and metered billing built in.
